items.t: Connecting rod bearings can fail and ruin the engine (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine and replace engine if bearings are damaged
items.note: Free under recalls 22V-753 (2022-2023) and 23V-593 (2024). Out of warranty, a replacement engine would cost several thousand dollars.

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
items.note: The 2.0T pump sits under the intake manifold, which adds labor. RepairPal lists engine front cover gasket work on the Atlas at $550–635.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,670–1,899 for an Atlas radiator replacement at a shop; CarComplaints owners report about $800.

items.t: Battery keeps going dead
items.job: Test for parasitic draw and replace 12V AGM battery
items.note: The battery must be coded to the car after replacement.
